notes.zh: 触发：游戏开始后由开局事件闸门 country.900 抽取（events/game_start.txt:15 在460±60天后触发；events/country_events_2.txt:17-66 为按权重的随机列表，四条开局故事互斥，另有69%什么都不发生）。权重10；“年轻”、虚空居民或破碎环起源为0；非集群意识、非“生命播种”起源、非游牧（country_events_2.txt:1889-1897）。
notes.en: Trigger: After game start the starting-event gate country.900 draws it (events/game_start.txt:15 fires it after 460±60 days; events/country_events_2.txt:17-66 is a weighted random list: the four opening stories are mutually exclusive and 69% of the weight is "nothing happens"). Weight 10; 0 for young, void dweller or shattered ring origins; non-gestalt, not Life Seeded, not nomadic (country_events_2.txt:1889-1897).

notes.zh: 两个选项都结束事件链：a 为物理加社会研究，b 为影响力加团结（country_events_2.txt:3123-3153）。
notes.en: Both options end the chain: a gives physics and society research, b influence and unity (country_events_2.txt:3123-3153).
